question: How many Bronze medals were won by India at Tokyo Olympics 2020 (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Four.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
